scope.description: One literal path/glob, or multiple scopes as an array, e.g. ["src","spec"]. A space in one string belongs to that path.

output.description: matches (default): located hits with aliases; files: every matching path with its matching-line count; count: totals only.

caseSensitive.description: Text and regex searches ignore case unless true.

context.description: Lines of surrounding source shown with each text match, grep -C style (12: match, 11- context).

limit.description: Results per page: 8 matches or 50 files by default.

offset.description: Results to skip; a limited result returns the next page as nextSearch.
